diagnostics.message: The null_resource "update_app" registers the GitHub App webhook by running a local-exec script against the API Gateway endpoint. Its only reference to the endpoint chain resolves to aws_apigatewayv2_api.webhook, so Terraform may run the script after the API object exists but before the webhook route, AWS_PROXY integration, and $default stage are deployed — at which point the endpoint returns 404 and the GitHub App would be configured with a non-functional webhook (masked by on_failure = continue). It should explicitly wait for the webhook module's route/integration/stage to be in place.
